project_title: Odoo Overdue Invoice & Automated Reminders Platform
language_context: Dutch (Nederlands) primary UI labels, English/Dutch bilingual support

theme_strategy.description: High-density tactical dark theme optimized for long financial sessions, with crisp light-mode option. Zero glare, high contrast data legibility.

typography.anti_default_rule: Strictly NO Inter for main section headings or metric callouts. Use Plus Jakarta Sans (bold/extra-bold, tracking-tight) for headings and JetBrains Mono for invoice numbers, amounts, dates, and days overdue.

hierarchy.caption_label: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-mono font-medium text-slate-400

layout_and_spacing.grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Dashboard Grid
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for buttons/inputs, rounded-full for status badges

login_and_mfa.description: Secure login with email/password followed by TOTP MFA QR enrollment and 6-digit verification code step.

odoo_invoice_table.description: Interactive data grid showing overdue invoices fetched from Odoo API with columns for Customer, Invoice #, Amount (€), Due Date, Days Overdue, Active Schedule, and Quick Send Action.
features: Bulk selection for batch reminder sending

reminder_action_modal.description: Send immediate manual or test reminders via Office 365 Email or WhatsApp Twilio, with automatic notification dispatch to Discord #odoo.

schedule_settings_drawer.description: Automated schedule rules (e.g., Send 1st reminder at +3 days overdue, 2nd at +7 days, escalate to WhatsApp at +14 days).

reminder_activity_log.description: Historical timeline audit log of sent reminders with delivery status, timestamp, target email/phone, and Discord notification status.

settings_page.description: Connection test panel for Odoo API URL/Database/API Key, Discord Webhook URL & #odoo channel name, Office 365 OAuth credentials, and WhatsApp API configuration.

testing_requirements.rule: ALL interactive components, form fields, action buttons, table rows, badges, and modals MUST include a clear kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components are built using React .js files.
Maintain high UI/UX visual standard with dark glassmorphism surfaces, vibrant status badges (Discord purple #5865F2, WhatsApp green #25D366, Office blue #0078D4, Odoo magenta #714B67).
Ensure Dutch business terms are used naturally alongside standard English UI options (e.g. 'Vervallen Facturen', 'Herinnering Sturen', 'Tijdsschema', 'Odoo Koppeling').
Add toast notifications via sonner for actions like sending reminders, updating settings, or testing Discord webhooks.
Implement data-testid attributes strictly as defined.
